records.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
WITH hourly_avg AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
    vessel,
    AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= '2026-09-14 23:59:54'::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 days'
  GROUP BY
    hour,
    vessel
)
SELECT
  hour,
  vessel,
  avg_wind
FROM hourly_avg
ORDER BY
  hour,
  vessel

records.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
WITH
  latest_ts AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(ts) AS max_ts
    FROM
      telemetry
  ),
  filtered_telemetry AS (
    SELECT
      ts,
      water_temp
    FROM
      telemetry,
      latest_ts
    WHERE
      vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= latest_ts.max_ts - INTERVAL '7 days'
  )
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts),
  AVG(water_temp)
FROM
  filtered_telemetry
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1

records.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
WITH
  latest_ts AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(ts) AS max_ts
    FROM
      telemetry
  ),
  ten_min_intervals AS (
    SELECT
      time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minute', ts) AS bucket,
      vessel,
      AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
    FROM
      telemetry,
      latest_ts
    WHERE
      ts >= latest_ts.max_ts - INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      vessel
  )
SELECT
  bucket,
  vessel,
  avg_speed
FROM
  ten_min_intervals
WHERE
  vessel = 'Atlas'
ORDER BY
  bucket,
  vessel
